title: Ex-Right Adjustment Module (F-018)
description: Create synapse/core/market/adjustment.py with AdjustmentType enum, AdjustmentEvent and AdjustmentFactors frozen dataclasses. Implement forward/backward price adjustment using Decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP. Integrate with data_loader.py via optional adj_type parameter (default NONE for backward compatibility). Parquet storage in data/adjustments/.
convergence: AdjustmentEvent frozen dataclass: date, factor, event_type, cash_dividend, stock_dividend
AdjustmentFactors frozen dataclass: symbol, events, cumulative tuple
get_adjustment_factors loads from Parquet or returns empty factors on missing file
adjust_single_price for single price point adjustment
Invalid factor (< 0 or > 10) logs warning and skips event
data_loader.py load_daily() gains adj_type: AdjustmentType = NONE parameter
Default adj_type=NONE preserves all existing load_daily() behavior
New unit tests: forward/backward adjustment, round-half-up, missing file, invalid factor, adj_type parameter
